description: Day-ahead total generation forecast for the Slovak (SEPS) control area. Source page: https://iop-transparency.entsoe.eu/generation/forecast/dayAhead
_areas_note: Countries / control areas to scrape, as '<AREA_TYPE>|<EIC>' strings. Add more entries to cover more countries in the same run -- each one becomes its own set of rows, distinguished by the dim_AREA column. Verified example: 'CTA|10YCZ-CEPS-----N' (Czechia), 'CTA|10YAT-APG------L' (Austria).
_request_template_note: Verified against the live endpoint (HTTP 200). The schema was recovered from the platform's own webpack sourcemaps: see getDtoInByOptions() in core/contexts/data-view-data-context-provider.js, which builds exactly {dateTimeRange, areaList, timeZone, sorterList, intervalPageInfo}. Two gotchas: areaList is a LIST of 'AREATYPE|EIC' strings, and the WAF rejects the literal 2147483647 (Integer.MAX_VALUE) anywhere in the body with a 403, so keep pageSize well below it.
